original_marker_in_paper: mitochondrial 12S; this design extracts mitochondrial 16S from annotated accessions
target: Scleractinia including reef and non-reef/deep-water taxa
source_taxonomy: GenBank source taxonomy; family labels and synonyms have not all been externally revised
release: Independent Refertina/Vacatina F/R pairs at fixed M coordinates

shared_F_search.selection: Within two species of the best union coverage, maximize exact paired matches; then coverage and minimum suborder coverage
shared_F_search.thermodynamics: 50 nM per variant and 200 nM F total / 100 nM each R total; entire 3-oligo mixture checked

independent_suborder_search.terminal3: IUPAC compatible for coverage; definite GC in candidate terminal3
independent_suborder_search.selection: Per suborder: within two covered species of optimum, maximize exact matching. R-D final selection preserves best SD+M coverage/exact union, minimizes maximum background count, then maximizes Refertina exact matching and minimizes total background.
independent_suborder_search.PCR_layout: separate suborder reactions; mixed 4-oligo cross-pairs evaluated as a sensitivity analysis
